run_deconvnet_saliency: run the DeConvNet attribution method on a model to compute saliency maps for a given category
get_example_data: get example model, input tensor, and category ID data for benchmarking with torchray
use_deconvnet_context: use the DeConvNetContext manager to modify ReLU backward passes for gradient-based attribution
convert_gradient_to_saliency: convert a tensor's gradient into a saliency map using gradient_to_saliency
plot_saliency_example: plot an input image alongside its computed saliency map using plot_example
